notes: Palette read from the site's own :root + season classes, corroborated by the screenshot. bg is warm paper #f9f9f3 (NOT #fff) and fg is forest ink #29382b (NOT #000); the raw profile confirms the same value serves as `color` on 415 nodes and `border-color` on 378 — borders ARE the ink, so no separate border token exists. `muted` is not a hex in the source: the site dims via `opacity: 0.6`, so it is recorded as the resolved rgba. `accent` is honestly a stretch — the only non-ink chrome color is the newsletter Submit fill #465443 on #ecefdf (a second step of the season ramp); the page has NO chromatic accent and no rendered semantic palette (--color-alert/-error/-success exist in :root but never paint). Photography carries all chroma. The homepage ships `season-vegetable`; sibling classes (season-forest, season-ocean) each remap --color-background/--color-foreground from an 8-step ramp — the theming axis is seasonal, not light/dark, so `color.dark` is omitted (craft.theme.supportsDark: false). Type: --font-size-1..8 collapsed to the 8 rem rungs above; the three largest are fluid clamp() (kept under `fluid`). Display:body ratio is only ~4x (72px/18px desktop). Leading 1.8 for body is the site's dominant line box (32.4px on 18px, 175 nodes). Tracking ramps inversely with size (-0.02em on h1-h3, -0.01em on h4-h5, +0.01em on body/h6). Measure ~45ch measured off the letter column in frame s04 (~360px of 18px serif). space: from --spacing: 1.25rem and its calc() derivatives; --spacing-xl: 112px is the one hand-set step; the 5.28px/7.92px/14.4px values in the raw profile are cookie-plugin em-derived padding and were dropped. radius 0 is the theme's own (`border-radius: 0px` on every button); the 6px/12px/50% entries in the raw profile belong to the cookie banner and Klaviyo widgets — dropped. shadow: the two captured box-shadows are likewise third-party (Klaviyo modal, WP lightbox); theme CSS has none, and craft.elevation.gradients is empty. MOTION: near-zero by intent. The probe's 2 scroll_effects are both `pin (fixed)` on the cookie banner and Klaviyo teaser — dropped as third-party chrome, not design. 9 IntersectionObservers and 15 rAF calls likewise trace to Klaviyo/analytics; 30 of the 35 @keyframes are vendored (klaviyo-*, cmplz-*, WP lightbox), leaving only fadeVideoIn and `slide` (mobile subscribe bar) as authored motion. The frame sequence shows no entrance, pin, parallax or recolor between stops, and no sticky header (--site-header-height: 0) — the header scrolls away, which the frames confirm. `position: sticky` IS used, but only section-scoped (gallery text column, listing headers). reduced_motion: respected via a global `* { animation-duration: .01ms !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important }` — note this does not stop the looping <video>. A11y from the craft probe: focus_visible true (a dashed border-bottom, not an outline), img_alt_ratio 1.0 across 20 images, but 33 of 79 interactive elements are sub-44px.
